content.title: Study Overview
content.description: In this study Rishabh focused on preprocessing methylation data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) for Lung Adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma (LUSC) to identify potential cancer biomarkers. The analysis leverages CpG and gene-level methylation profiles, processed using Python with pandas and numpy libraries.
content.sauravdesription: While Saurav cancer is one of the most prevalent types of cancer worldwide. Identifying differentially expressed genes (DEGs) can help in early detection and understanding disease mechanisms. This study focuses on preprocessing and analyzing microarray data from the E-MEXP-3756 dataset, using statistical and bioinformatics techniques in R.
content.mohitdescription: While Mohit focused on proteomic datasets for cardiovascular, melanin, and respiratory diseases, his research extended to analyzing methylation data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) for Lung Adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma (LUSC) to identify potential cancer biomarkers. The study leveraged CpG and gene-level methylation profiles, processed using Python with pandas and numpy libraries to extract meaningful insights.

content.title: Intution
content.description: The selection of diseases, including cardiovascular, respiratory, and neoplastic conditions, was driven by their high mortality rates in India, as highlighted in statistical reports. Cardiovascular diseases emerged as the leading cause of death, followed closely by respiratory diseases and malignant neoplasms, making them critical areas for biomarker identification and early detection strategies.

content.title: Datasets
content.description: The study utilizes four methylation datasets from TCGA, processed on January 28, 2016, using the Illumina HumanMethylation450 BeadChip (Meth450) platform by Johns Hopkins University and USC. while Saurav had E-MEXP-3756 (ArrayExpress) with  CEL files (expression data), SDRF file (Sample and Data Relationship Format) (sample metadata), IDF file (experiment description)

content.title: Key Observations
content.description: Insights derived from the preprocessing of Genomic and Sequential Data.

points: Rishabh Used, LUAD datasets (CpG and Gene) which includes 459 samples, with CpG data spanning 40230 CpG sites and gene data covering 20115 genes it also included 371 samples, with similar CpG and gene coverage.
Combined dataset integrates 829 unique samples (458 LUAD + 371 LUSC), with some columns containing NaN values due to non-overlapping sample IDs between LUAD and LUSC.
Genes such as RBL2, VDAC3, ACTN1, ATP2A1, and SFRP1 exhibit distinct methylation profiles across LUAD and LUSC samples, suggesting potential biomarker candidates.
